CodDesc.name: FACOLTA
CodDesc.whereCondition: 1=1 group by FACOLTA order by FACOLTA

CodDesc.name: DIRETTI
CodDesc.whereCondition: A.AGE_C_AGE = H.AGE_KEY_C and H.DATA_FINE_STRUT = '2099-12-31' and H.AGE_COORD_KEY_C = ? and H.LIV_PROF_DA_COORD in (0,1)

Access.name: elencoAgenti
Access.Query:
select distinct A.AGE_C_AGE, A.RETEVEND_C_RETE, A.AGE_M_COGN_AGE, A.AGE_M_NOME_AGE, A.AGE_C_AREA, A.SERVER_C_REPLICA, A.AGZPI_C_AGZ, B.AGZPI_X_COMU, B.PROV_C_PROV, D.TIPCONTRAGE_T_CONTR_AGE, D.CICLOVITA_C_CICLO_VITA from INR_AGENTI A, INR_AGENZIE B, INR_AGENTI_RPLC C, INR_AGE D where A.AGZPI_C_AGZ *= B.AGZPI_C_AGZ and A.AGE_C_AGE *= C.AGE_C_AGE and A.AGE_C_AGE *= D.AGE_C_AGE and D.CICLOVITA_C_CICLO_VITA = 'A' and A.AGE_C_AGE =
params_codAgente and A.AGE_M_COGN_AGE like
params_cognomeAgente%

Access.name: elencoAgentiGlobalSpecialist
Access.Query:
select distinct AGE_C_AGE, RETEVEND_C_RETE, AGE_M_COGN_AGE, AGE_M_NOME_AGE from INR_AGENTI_RPLC where (AGE_D_DIMI_AGE is null or AGE_D_DIMI_AGE > getdate()) and AGE_X_QUALIFICA in ('AGENZIA DI SEGNALAZIONE','AG. TRADIZ. MED') and AGE_C_AGE =
params_codAgente and AGE_M_COGN_AGE like
params_cognomeAgente%

Access.name: elencoClienti
Access.Query:
select B.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL, A.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE, A.CLI_X_CF, A.CLI_N_PIVA, CASE CLI_C_NATURA_GIURIDICA WHEN 'SFF' THEN CLI_X_SECONDA_INTEST WHEN 'SMM' THEN CLI_X_SECONDA_INTEST ELSE CLI_M_COGN END AS COGNOME, CASE CLI_C_NATURA_GIURIDICA WHEN 'SFF' THEN CLI_M_COGN+' '+CLI_M_NOME WHEN 'SMM' THEN CLI_M_COGN+' '+CLI_M_NOME ELSE CLI_M_NOME END AS NOME, A.STATOCLI_C_STATO, '0', A.CLI_D_NASC, B.AGE_C_AGE, A.CLI_F_SESSO, A.CLI_F_BSN_CLB, A.CLI_F_CLI_DA_ESTRA, A.CLI_F_TOPBSN, B.AGE_C_AGE, B.AGE_C_AGE, B.RETEVEND_C_RETE, C.AGE_M_COGN_AGE, C.AGE_M_NOME_AGE, C.AGE_C_AREA, C.SERVER_C_REPLICA, C.AGZPI_C_AGZ ,D.AGZPI_X_DENOM_AGZ, D.PROV_C_PROV, C.TIPCONTRAGE_T_CONTR_AGE, C.CICLOVITA_C_CICLO_VITA, A.CLI_C_NATURA_GIURIDICA, A.CLI_X_SECONDA_INTEST, A.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE_NEW from DBA.INR_CLI as A, DBA.INR_CODIFCLIMEDL as B, DBA.INR_AGE as C, DBA.INR_AGZPI as D where A.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE = B.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE and B.AGE_C_AGE = C.AGE_C_AGE and C.AGZPI_C_AGZ *= D.AGZPI_C_AGZ and B.AGE_C_AGE =
params_codAgente and B.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL =
params_codMediolanum and A.CLI_M_NOME LIKE
params_nome% and A.CLI_M_COGN LIKE
params_cognome%
and A.CLI_M_COGN LIKE 'A%'
AND (A.BLOCCOBANCA_C_BLOCCO_BANCA IS NULL OR A.BLOCCOBANCA_C_BLOCCO_BANCA NOT IN ('K'))
AND A.CLI_F_SESSO = 'S'
and ((A.CLI_C_NATURA_GIURIDICA is null and A.CLI_F_SESSO != 'S') or A.CLI_C_NATURA_GIURIDICA in ('FMM','FFF'))
order by A.CLI_M_COGN, A.CLI_M_NOME

Access.name: elencoClientiPotenziali
Access.Query:
select null as CLIMED, A.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE, A.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE, A.CLI_M_COGN, A.CLI_M_NOME, A.CLI_D_NASC, A.AGE_C_AGE from CEPE_CLI_PROSPECT_RETE A where 1=1 and A.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE =
params_codMediolanum and A.AGE_C_AGE =
params_codAgente and A.CLI_M_NOME LIKE
params_nome% and A.CLI_M_COGN LIKE
params_cognome% UNION select null as CLIMED, A.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE, A.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE, A.CLI_M_COGN, A.CLI_M_NOME, A.CLI_D_NASC, A.AGE_C_AGE from INR_CLI_ELETTR A where 1=1 and A.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE =
params_codMediolanum and A.AGE_C_AGE =
params_codAgente and A.CLI_M_NOME LIKE
params_nome% and A.CLI_M_COGN LIKE
params_cognome% and A.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL is null

Access.name: elencoComuni
Access.Query:
SELECT DISTINCT COMU.COMU_X_DENOM_COMU, CAP.CAP_C_CAP, COMU.PROV_C_PROV, COMU.COMU_C_COMU FROM CLL.CAP CAP inner join CLL.V_COMU COMU on CAP.CAP_C_CAP BETWEEN COMU.CAP_C_AVVIAM_POSTL_MIN AND COMU.CAP_C_AVVIAM_POSTL_MAX inner join (select CAP_C_PROV PROV_C_PROV, max(DAT_FINE_VALID) PROV_D_FINE_VAL from CLL.CAP group by CAP_C_PROV) PROV on COMU.PROV_C_PROV = PROV.PROV_C_PROV WHERE PROV.PROV_D_FINE_VAL = to_date('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy') AND COMU.COMU_D_FINE_VAL = to_date('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy') AND COMU.COMU_X_DENOM_COMU like
comune% AND PROV.PROV_C_PROV like
provincia% AND CAP.CAP_C_CAP like
cap%

Access.name: elencoComuniIscrittiAlCatasto
Access.Query:
select distinct CATASTO.DEN_COMU , null , PROV.PROV_C_PROV , CATASTO.COD_CATAS_COMU from CLL.V_PROV PROV , CLL.ANAG_CATAST_COMUN CATASTO where CATASTO.COD_PROV = PROV.PROV_C_PROV and (CATASTO.COD_PROV != 'EE' OR (CATASTO.COD_PROV = 'EE' AND substr(CATASTO.COD_FISC_COMU,1) != 'Z')) and (PROV.PROV_D_FINE_VAL = to_date('31/12/9999','dd/mm/yyyy') or PROV.PROV_C_PROV = 'EE') AND CATASTO.DEN_COMU like
comune% AND PROV.PROV_C_PROV like
provincia%

Access.name: ricercaGlobaleClienti
Access.Query:
select B.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL, A.CLI_M_COGN+' '+A.CLI_M_NOME as COGNOME_NOME, A.STATOCLI_C_STATO, A.CLI_F_SESSO, A.CLI_X_CF, A.AGE_C_AGE, A.RETEVEND_C_RETE, A.CLI_D_NASC, case when A.CLI_N_PIVA = '00000000000' then '' else A.CLI_N_PIVA end as PARTITA_IVA, case when A.CLI_X_COMU_NASC is null then C.COMU_X_DENOM_COMU else A.CLI_X_COMU_NASC end as CLI_X_COMU_NASC from DBA.INR_CLI as A, DBA.INR_CODIFCLIMEDL as B, DBA.INR_COMU as C where A.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE = B.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE and A.AGE_C_AGE != '0000000000' and A.COMU_C_COMU_NASC *= C.COMU_C_COMU and A.AGE_C_AGE =
params_codAgente and B.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL =
params_codMediolanum and A.CLI_M_COGN LIKE
params_cognome% and A.CLI_M_NOME LIKE
params_nome%
and A.CLI_M_COGN LIKE 'A%'
order by COGNOME_NOME

Access.name: elencoAgentiCliente
Access.Query: select A.AGE_C_AGE, B.AGE_M_COGN_AGE, B.AGE_M_NOME_AGE, A.ASSGNCLIAGE_D_INIZ_ASSGN, A.ASSGNCLIAGE_D_FINE_ASSGN from DBA.INR_ASSGNCLIAGE as A, DBA.INR_AGE as B where A.AGE_C_AGE = B.AGE_C_AGE and A.CODIFCLIMEDL_C_CLI_MEDL = ? order by A.ASSGNCLIAGE_D_INIZ_ASSGN desc

Access.name: elencoUniversita
Access.Query:
select PROGRESSIVO ,NOME_UNIVERSITA ,FACOLTA ,SIGLA_PROVINCIA from CEPE_ATENEI_UNIVERSITARI where DATA_FINE_VALIDITA is null and upper(NOME_UNIVERSITA) like
%ateneo% and FACOLTA =
facolta and SIGLA_PROVINCIA =
provincia order by NOME_UNIVERSITA, SIGLA_PROVINCIA

Access.name: elencoMandatiM4U
Access.Query: select COD_CLIENTE , COGNOME , NOME , DATA_NASCITA from ARC_MANDATO_M4U where COD_SOGGETTO = ? and COD_STATO_MANDATO = 'EMESS' and getdate() between DATA_INIZIO and DATA_FINE
